svg.title: Rounding rule: the leftover paise of a split
svg.desc: Rs 1000.00 split equally three ways is 33333 paise each with 1 paisa left, which goes to the first person listed. Rs 10.00 at 33.33, 33.33 and 33.34 percent is 333.3, 333.3 and 333.4 paise, floored to 333 each with 1 paisa left, which goes to the largest remainder. Both splits add up to the total exactly.
svg.text: Rs 1000.00, equal over asha, bala, chetan
1000 paise × percent, floored: 999 paise, 1 left over
